# iam (iam.origincloudapis.eu)

Guide: <https://docs.origincloud.eu/docs/iam/index.html.md>

- **AuditLogService**: An organization's audit log: a record of each change to who may do what in it, written when the change is made and never changed afterwards.
- **FederatedCredentialService**: Federated credentials: a `WORKLOAD` service account's trust in the OIDC tokens of an identity provider outside Origin Cloud, such as the token GitHub Actions gives every job.
- **PermissionService**: The catalog of permissions, and which of them a caller holds.
- **RoleService**: The catalog of predefined roles.
- **RoleBindingService**: Role bindings: each grants one role to one member, in a whole organization or in one of its projects.
- **ServiceAccountService**: Service accounts: an organization's credentials for software, which authenticate with the OAuth 2.0 client credentials grant and never log in interactively.
- **UserService**: The signed-in user.

## Packages

| Language | Install | Import |

| Rust | `cargo add origincloud-iam@0.25.0` | `origincloud_iam::v1beta1` |

| TypeScript | `npm install @origincloud/core@0.26.0 @origincloud/iam@0.26.0` | `@origincloud/iam/v1beta1` |

## Ask before

These delete something or can't be undone: show the user what will change and wait for their yes.

- `DeleteFederatedCredential`: deletes for good.
- `DeleteRoleBinding`: deletes for good.
- `DeleteServiceAccount`: deletes for good.

## FederatedCredentialService

Federated credentials: a `WORKLOAD` service account's trust in the OIDC tokens of an identity provider outside Origin Cloud, such as the token GitHub Actions gives every job.

| Language | Client |
|---|---|
| Rust | `FederatedCredentialClient::new(&client)` |
| Go | `iamv1beta1.NewFederatedCredentialClient(client)` |
| TypeScript | `new FederatedCredentialClient(client)` |

| RPC | Rust | Go | TypeScript | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GetFederatedCredential` (`GetFederatedCredentialRequest`) | `get_federated_credential` | `GetFederatedCredential` | `getFederatedCredential` | Returns a federated credential, deleted or not. requires `name` |
| `ListFederatedCredentials` (`ListFederatedCredentialsRequest`) | `list_federated_credentials`, `all_federated_credentials` | `ListFederatedCredentials`, `AllFederatedCredentials` | `listFederatedCredentials`, `allFederatedCredentials` | Lists a service account's federated credentials, oldest first. requires `parent` |
| `CreateFederatedCredential` (`CreateFederatedCredentialRequest`) | `create_federated_credential` | `CreateFederatedCredential` | `createFederatedCredential` | Creates a federated credential on an active `WORKLOAD` service account. a retry with the same `request_id` is safe; requires `parent`, `federated_credential` |
| `DeleteFederatedCredential` (`DeleteFederatedCredentialRequest`) | `delete_federated_credential` | `DeleteFederatedCredential` | `deleteFederatedCredential` | Deletes a federated credential: no token is exchanged for it from then on, and an access token already exchanged for it is refused on its next request. **ask first**: deletes for good; requires `name` |

## ServiceAccountService

Service accounts: an organization's credentials for software, which authenticate with the OAuth 2.0 client credentials grant and never log in interactively.

| Language | Client |
|---|---|
| Rust | `ServiceAccountClient::new(&client)` |
| Go | `iamv1beta1.NewServiceAccountClient(client)` |
| TypeScript | `new ServiceAccountClient(client)` |

| RPC | Rust | Go | TypeScript | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GetServiceAccount` (`GetServiceAccountRequest`) | `get_service_account` | `GetServiceAccount` | `getServiceAccount` | Returns a service account, deleted or not. requires `name` |
| `ListServiceAccounts` (`ListServiceAccountsRequest`) | `list_service_accounts`, `all_service_accounts` | `ListServiceAccounts`, `AllServiceAccounts` | `listServiceAccounts`, `allServiceAccounts` | Lists an organization's service accounts, oldest first. requires `parent` |
| `CreateServiceAccount` (`CreateServiceAccountRequest`) | `create_service_account` | `CreateServiceAccount` | `createServiceAccount` | Creates a service account and, for an `EXTERNAL` one, its client secret, which expires after `secret_lifetime`. a retry with the same `request_id` is safe; no MCP tool: Creating a service account answers with its client secret, once; a tool would put working credentials into the model's context. Service accounts are created with the CLI, the console or Terraform; requires `parent`, `service_account` |
| `RotateServiceAccountSecret` (`RotateServiceAccountSecretRequest`) | `rotate_service_account_secret` | `RotateServiceAccountSecret` | `rotateServiceAccountSecret` | Issues a new client secret for an `EXTERNAL` service account and returns the service account with it in `client_secret`, the only place it is ever shown. a retry with the same `request_id` is safe; no MCP tool: Rotating a service account's secret answers with the new client secret, once; a tool would put working credentials into the model's context. Secrets are rotated with the CLI, the console or Terraform; requires `name` |
| `DeleteServiceAccount` (`DeleteServiceAccountRequest`) | `delete_service_account` | `DeleteServiceAccount` | `deleteServiceAccount` | Deletes a service account for good: its credential is refused from then on, an access token it already holds is refused on its next request, and every role binding it holds, in any organization, is removed. **ask first**: deletes for good; requires `name` |

## Resources

### AuditLogEntry

One recorded change.

- Full name: `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/organizations/{organization}/auditLogEntries/{audit_log_entry}`
- `name`: `organizations/{organization}/auditLogEntries/{audit_log_entry}`

| Field (JSON) | Type | Behavior | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | identifier | The entry's resource name. |
| `project` | string | output only | The project the change was limited to, `projects/{project}`; empty for a change to the whole organization. |
| `actor` | string | output only | Who made the change, as it was when the change was made: `user:{email}` with the verified address the account had then, `userId:{user}` when none was recorded, `serviceAccount:{service_account}`, or `platform` for a change the platform made itself. |
| `action` | string | output only | What was done, as a permission key names it, such as `iam.role.assign`. |
| `target` | string | output only | What it was done to, written as `actor` is, or the email address invited; empty when the action has no target. |
| `outcome` | AuditLogEntry.Outcome | output only | Whether the change was made. One of `SUCCEEDED`, `DENIED`. |
| `occurTime` | timestamp | output only | When the change was made. |
| `details` | map<string, string> | output only | Details of the change that depend on the action, such as the `role` granted or a service account's `display_name`. |

### FederatedCredential

A `WORKLOAD` service account's trust in an identity provider's OIDC tokens that carry the given claims.

- Full name: `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/organizations/{organization}/serviceAccounts/{service_account}/federatedCredentials/{federated_credential}`
- `name`: `organizations/{organization}/serviceAccounts/{service_account}/federatedCredentials/{federated_credential}`

| Field (JSON) | Type | Behavior | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | identifier | The federated credential's resource name. |
| `displayName` | string | required, immutable | A name of your own, shown in the console; at most 100 characters. |
| `issuer` | string | required, immutable | The identity provider whose tokens are trusted: a token's `iss`, matched exactly, an `https` URL that serves `/.well-known/openid-configuration`, such as `https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com`. |
| `audience` | string | optional, immutable | The audience a token must be issued for, its `aud`, matched exactly; `https://sts.origincloudapis.eu` when the create leaves it empty. |
| `conditions` | map<string, string> | required, immutable | The claims a token must carry, each with exactly this value, such as `repository_id` and `environment` for GitHub Actions. |
| `state` | FederatedCredential.State | output only | Where the federated credential is in its lifecycle. One of `ACTIVE`, `DELETED`. |
| `creator` | string | output only | Who created the federated credential, written as a role binding's member is. |
| `createTime` | timestamp | output only | When the federated credential was created. |
| `deleteTime` | timestamp | output only | When the federated credential was deleted; unset while it is active. |

### Permission

One action on one kind of resource, which a role grants.

- Full name: `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/permissions/{permission}`
- `name`: `permissions/{permission}`

| Field (JSON) | Type | Behavior | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | identifier | The permission's resource name, `permissions/{service}.{resource}.{action}`, such as `permissions/pvs.volume.create`. |
| `urn` | string | output only | The permission's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use. |
| `service` | string | output only | The service whose API checks it, such as `pvs`. |
| `resourceType` | string | output only | The kind of resource it applies to, such as `volume`. |
| `action` | string | output only | The action it allows, such as `create`. |

### Role

A predefined role: a named set of permissions that a role binding grants.

- Full name: `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/roles/{role}`
- `name`: `roles/{role}`

| Field (JSON) | Type | Behavior | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | identifier | The role's resource name, such as `roles/owner`, `roles/viewer` or `roles/billing.administrator`. |
| `urn` | string | output only | The role's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use. |
| `displayName` | string | output only | The name the console shows, such as `Owner`. |
| `description` | string | output only | What holding the role allows, in a sentence. |
| `includedPermissions` | repeated string | output only | The permissions the role grants, `permissions/{permission}`, in catalog order. Names a `Permission`. |

### RoleBinding

One role granted to one member, organization-wide or in one project.

- Full name: `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/organizations/{organization}/roleBindings/{role_binding}`
- `name`: `organizations/{organization}/roleBindings/{role_binding}`

| Field (JSON) | Type | Behavior | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | identifier | The binding's resource name. |
| `urn` | string | output only | The binding's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use. |
| `member` | string | required, immutable | Who holds the role: `user:{email}` or `serviceAccount:{service_account}`. |
| `role` | string | required, immutable | The role granted, `roles/{role}`. Names a `Role`. |
| `project` | string | optional, immutable | The project the binding is limited to, `projects/{project}`, one of the organization's. |
| `creator` | string | output only | Who created the binding, written as a member is, or `platform` for a binding the platform made itself. |
| `createTime` | timestamp | output only | When the binding was created. |

### ServiceAccount

A credential of an organization for software.

- Full name: `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/organizations/{organization}/serviceAccounts/{service_account}`
- `name`: `organizations/{organization}/serviceAccounts/{service_account}`

| Field (JSON) | Type | Behavior | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | identifier | The service account's resource name. |
| `displayName` | string | required, immutable | A name of your own, shown in the console; at most 100 characters. |
| `member` | string | output only | The member a role binding names it by, `serviceAccount:{service_account}`. |
| `clientId` | string | output only | The OAuth 2.0 client id it authenticates with; empty for a `WORKLOAD` service account. |
| `clientSecret` | string | output only | The OAuth 2.0 client secret it authenticates with. |
| `state` | ServiceAccount.State | output only | Where the service account is in its lifecycle. One of `ACTIVE`, `DELETED`. |
| `creator` | string | output only | Who created the service account, written as a role binding's member is. |
| `createTime` | timestamp | output only | When the service account was created. |
| `deleteTime` | timestamp | output only | When the service account was deleted; unset while it is active. |
| `type` | ServiceAccount.Type | optional, immutable | How the service account authenticates; `EXTERNAL` when the create leaves it unset. One of `EXTERNAL`, `WORKLOAD`. |
| `secretExpireTime` | timestamp | output only | When the client secret expires. |

### User

A person who signs in to the platform.

- Full name: `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/users/{user}`
- `name`: `users/{user}`

| Field (JSON) | Type | Behavior | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | identifier | The user's resource name, `users/{user}`, with their id; never `users/me`. |
| `member` | string | output only | How a role binding shows the user: `user:{email}` once `email` is verified, `userId:{user}` until then. |
| `email` | string | output only | The email address the user signs in with. |
| `emailVerified` | bool | output only | Whether the user has confirmed `email`. |
| `givenName` | string | output only | The user's given name; empty when they haven't set one. |
| `familyName` | string | output only | The user's family name; empty when they haven't set one. |
